correctness.rationale: For each fixed p,q>0, normalized weighted Bergman monomials diagonalize radial annulus localization. The beta-prime density g_{p,k}(t)=Γ(k+p+1)t^k/[Γ(k+1)Γ(p)(1+t)^{k+p+1}] sums pointwise to p by the binomial series, proving exact trace pL and trace class without relying on finite truncation. Incomplete-beta recurrence yields sign(λ_{k+1}−λ_k)=sign(H_{p,S,L}−(k+1)), giving a unique maximizing degree floor H unless integral H=m yields a two-mode tie m−1,m. Uniform gamma-ratio bounds and log(1+1/t)≥1/(1+t) give λ_k≤C(L/S)(1+k/S)^p exp[−k/((2+R)S)] when L/S≤R. For L/S→0, (S/L)λ_{floor cS}→c^p exp(−c)/Γ(p), and all q>0 Schatten trace powers converge by dominated Riemann sums to Γ(pq+1)/(q^{pq+1}Γ(p)^q). For L/S→ρ>0 the rescaled degree profile is the gamma interval mass ∫_{c/(1+ρ)}^c x^{p−1}exp(−x)dx/Γ(p), its derivative has one sign change at c=p(1+ρ)log(1+ρ)/ρ, and the exponential tail yields the full trace/norm claims. Independent p=1 case λ_k=v^{k+1}−u^{k+1}, trace=L and ρ=1 limit maximum 1/4 corroborate. Finite package check is not the proof.
